SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 900/12
Special Branch
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
Date July 26, 1941.

Subject (in full) U.S. Marshal Office :- Enquiries re William Albert Scott et al

Made by D.S. Crook Forwarded by

In response to an enquiry from the Office of the U.S.
Marshal, the following particulars are forwarded:-

William Albert Scott :- No record.
Francisco Alvarado Busto :- No record.
Gunvor Flygare :- No record.
Alexander Solodovnikoff :- No record.
Feiga H. Isako, British subject by naturalization, wife
of Franz Isako, circus proprietor. Nothing
detrimental known.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH）
A. C. (Special Branch).

D. S. Crook
